empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Your past and current orders will show here.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.body: Try other words or change the filters.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't load the data. Try again.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: Check your connection, then try again.

denied.title: You don't have access
denied.body: Ask your account manager for access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page may still be in the works, or its address changed.

upload.failed: The file couldn't be uploaded. Try again.

login.phoneHint: We'll send you a verification code

errors.otpInvalid: Wrong code, or this number has no access. Try again.
errors.otpExpired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the JAZLA team.
errors.suspended: Your store is suspended. Contact the JAZLA team.

choose.title: Choose a dashboard
choose.body: Your number has access to more than one dashboard. Choose the one to open.

desc.admin: Orders, stores, delivery, finance and settings
desc.vendor: Your store’s orders, products and earnings
desc.kitchen: Cooking jobs for today and the days ahead

admin.title: Staff sign-in
admin.subtitle: Enter the mobile number registered with the admin team.
admin.footer: This dashboard is for authorised staff only.
admin.heroBody: Orders, stores, delivery and finance in one place. Authorised staff only.
admin.p1b: Follow every order from receipt to delivery
admin.p2b: Store sales and settlements in real time

vendor.title: Vendor sign-in
vendor.subtitle: Enter your business mobile number registered with JAZLA.
vendor.heroBody: Receive your orders, set slaughter times and follow your earnings in one place.
vendor.p1b: Instant alert for every new order
vendor.p2b: Weekly settlement to your bank account

kitchen.title: Kitchen sign-in
kitchen.subtitle: Enter the mobile number registered for your kitchen.
kitchen.footer: Kitchen accounts are created by the JAZLA team. Contact them if your number isn't registered.
kitchen.heroBody: Receive cooking tasks, update their status and hand them over on time.
kitchen.p1b: Sound alert for every new task
kitchen.p2b: Number of guests and customer notes
kitchen.p3b: Call the courier when it's ready

coverage.title: Coverage zones

hints.draw: Click the map to place the boundary points, then click the first point to close the zone.
hints.edit: Drag the points to change the boundary, or click a point to remove it.
hints.test: Click anywhere on the map to see whether it is covered.

form.body: Customers see the name when their address is checked. Inactive zones don't count as covered.

errors.invalidPolygon: The boundary isn't valid. Draw at least three points without crossing lines.
errors.notFound: This zone no longer exists, so we reloaded the list.

empty.title: No coverage zones
empty.body: Draw the first zone on the map to start taking orders from it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the zone?
deleteDialog.body: Orders from “{zone}” won't be accepted after it is deleted.

coverage.cityHint: Write the city name in Arabic, e.g. الرياض.
coverage.restored: We restored what you drew before signing in. Check it, then save.
